meta.description: ProxMenux installed on a Proxmox Backup Server host: how the server is detected, the supported versions, the PBS menu, the two ways to update its packages, the repository check, post-install and settings.

header.title: ProxMenux on Proxmox Backup Server
header.description: What ProxMenux does when it runs on a Proxmox Backup Server host: its own menu, package updates that keep the server's repositories, and the post-install adapted to a backup server.

blocks.p: ProxMenux treats a host as a Proxmox Backup Server when the package proxmox-backup-server is installed. The backup client alone, which many Proxmox VE hosts have, does not count. When Proxmox VE and Proxmox Backup Server are installed on the same host, Proxmox VE takes precedence and ProxMenux opens its usual menu. The Monitor uses the same detection.

On any other combination the PBS menu still opens, but the package update, the repository check and the System Utilities Installer stop with This operation supports PBS 3 on Debian 12 and PBS 4 on Debian 13.

ProxMenux installs on a Proxmox Backup Server with the same command as on Proxmox VE, described in Installing ProxMenux. The installer has no separate path for PBS: it also installs ProxMenux Monitor, which listens on port 8008. After the installation, menu opens the PBS menu. What the Monitor shows on the server is described in ProxMenux Monitor on Proxmox Backup Server.

sections.title: The PBS menu
sections.intro: On a Proxmox Backup Server host, menu opens a menu titled Proxmox Backup Server instead of the Proxmox VE main menu. The title is the same in every language.

The same installer as on Proxmox VE, described in <utilsLink>System Utilities Installer</utilsLink>. On PBS it installs from the repositories already configured and never changes them.

blocks.p: Options 2 to 4 only read: they show the command output in a text box. If the command fails, the box is titled Command failed and shows the error.

sections.title: Repositories
sections.intro: ProxMenux changes the APT sources of a Proxmox Backup Server only from the post-install: the system update and the Configure Proxmox APT repositories option of the Customizable script run the same check first. Option 6, the Monitor update and the System Utilities Installer use the sources as they are.

items: With a PBS no-subscription or test repository already enabled, nothing changes.

With an active subscription and a PBS repository, nothing changes. With an active subscription and no PBS repository, the check stops and asks you to configure the Enterprise source in Administration > Repositories.

Without a subscription, or with an expired one, the check needs an active Debian base repository. Then it asks before switching to the PBS no-subscription repository and disabling the Enterprise PBS source, which needs a subscription.
The switch goes through the server's own repository API, with proxmox-backup-debug api set /nodes/localhost/apt/repositories --handle no-subscription, and refreshes the package lists afterwards.
If you answer No, no source changes and the update stops. In noninteractive mode the check changes nothing and points to Administration > Repositories.
A PBS repository written for another Debian release stops the check, which names the file so you can correct it.

sections.title: Post-install
sections.intro: Settings post-install Proxmox opens the post-install menu of Proxmox VE, adapted to a backup server. What changes is listed in Post-install on Proxmox Backup Server. Two more details apply:

items: The Automated post-installation script runs the post-install system update described above, and asks before removing the subscription banner from the Proxmox Backup Server web interface.

Uninstall optimizations restores the web interface file from the backup ProxMenux made of it. When there is no usable backup, it reinstalls proxmox-widget-toolkit and libjs-extjs, the packages a Proxmox Backup Server has, instead of the Proxmox VE ones.

blocks.p: Settings opens the same settings menu as on Proxmox VE: the Monitor service, the release channel, the language, the version information and the uninstaller, described in Settings ProxMenux. Return to Main Menu goes back to the PBS menu.

sections.title: Watching a Proxmox Backup Server from Proxmox VE

blocks.p: This page covers ProxMenux installed on the backup server itself. To follow the datastores and tasks of a Proxmox Backup Server from a Proxmox VE host, see the <backupTabLink>Proxmox Backup Server view of the Backup tab</backupTabLink>.
